notes: taḥwīl «ح» joins two routes that meet at the teacher of the tail; the text writes «فأخبرني أبو سلمة ... عن جابر» once, after the last «ح», so it belongs to both branches (rule 3)
the first branch ends at ابن شهاب and the second at الزهري: the same man named twice in two wordings, kept as written
